summary_en: Toho Bank raised dividend forecasts for fiscal year ending March 2027, increasing interim and year-end dividends by 2.50 yen per share each to 13.00 yen, lifting annual dividend to 26.00 yen from 21.00 yen, with payout ratio of 40.6%.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision (Dividend Increase) of Interim and Year-End Dividend Forecasts for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027
translation_en_brief:
Toho Bank announced revisions to its dividend forecasts for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The interim dividend and year-end dividend were each increased by 2.50 yen per share, bringing both to 13.00 yen per share, compared to the previously forecast 10.50 yen. This lifts the combined annual dividend to 26.00 yen from the earlier forecast of 21.00 yen.

The revision reflects higher earnings projections driven primarily by increased fund profits, as disclosed on the same date. The bank also cited responding to shareholder support and alignment with its long-term management plan "TX PLAN 2030," which identifies shareholder return enhancement as one of three pillars of value creation.

With this adjustment, the payout ratio against net income attributable to parent company shareholders is expected to reach 40.6%, within the bank's shareholder return policy guideline of targeting a 40% payout ratio on a flexible basis.
